error.signature: AI tells someone in Sweden that official household emergency preparedness only requires 72 hours of self-sufficiency, or refers to 'MSB' as the current name of the responsible civil-defence agency

verdict.summary: Sweden's official crisis-information guidance (krisinformation.se) instructs households to plan to manage on their own for at least one week - longer if possible - covering water, food, heat, and communication, not the 72-hour window used in some neighbouring countries' messaging. Separately, the agency long known as MSB (Myndigheten for samhallsskydd och beredskap) was renamed Myndigheten for civilt forsvar (MCF), effective 1 January 2026 following the Riksdag's approval on 5 November 2025; its sites now carry the new name and the mcf.se domain.

dead_ends.action: State that Swedish official guidance recommends the same 72-hour self-sufficiency window used in Finland or other Nordic countries
dead_ends.why_fails: Sweden's official crisis-information site instructs households to 'plan to manage on your own for at least one week, preferably longer if you can' (minst en vecka) - a materially longer official target than a 72-hour framing, covering information, water, food, heat, and sleep.
dead_ends.condition: General household preparedness planning in Sweden
dead_ends.common_misconception: That Nordic countries standardized on the same 72-hour preparedness window in their official guidance.

dead_ends.action: Cite 'MSB' (Myndigheten for samhallsskydd och beredskap) as the current legal name of the agency responsible for this guidance
dead_ends.why_fails: The Riksdag approved renaming MSB to Myndigheten for civilt forsvar (MCF) on 5 November 2025, with the change taking effect 1 January 2026; the agency's own sites, including krisinformation.se, now display the new name, though 'MSB' may still linger in older, undated materials.
dead_ends.condition: Any reference to the agency dated after 1 January 2026
dead_ends.common_misconception: That the broschure-era name 'MSB' is still the agency's current legal name.

workarounds.action: Follow krisinformation.se's household checklist: plan for at least one week of drinking water and food that needs little water or refrigeration, a non-electric heat source, and a battery or hand-crank radio for official emergency broadcasts
